work.description: The act commits to the archbishop of Naples permission for Mass in Stefano Tanchi's chapel at Capodimonte. Issuer evidence ’ GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF11378; own dating clause LF11459–11462 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die sexta decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF11427 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
